metadata.description: Context and cost tooling for Claude Code: claude-context-optimizer.

plugins.name: claude-context-optimizer
plugins.description: Cuts wasted context in Claude Code and shows what each session really costs. Model-aware for the Claude 5 lineup (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1) with 1-hour-cache pricing and cache-break warnings; read dedup and file digests; auto .contextignore; a ru/en prompt coach; task state that survives /compact; and a one-screen /cco control center. Runs locally, no network calls.
